continuity.arc_goal: Implement complete linked services system: Phase A (object-to-object linking with completion and handlers), Phase A.2 (refactor completion model to LinkedFrom sinks), Phase B (workflow invocation linking with InvocationEdges and coupled semantics).

progress_update.summary: Designed Phase A.2 (link completion model refactor + AttachLinkCommand) and Phase B (workflow invocation linking) through extensive design discussion. Produced two approved implementation plans and a combined 25-subtask breakdown. Key design innovations: LinkedFrom records as completion sinks, unified LinkCompletionNotification with source/result/sink fields, two edge tables (ServiceEdges for VO parents, InvocationEdges for WI parents), and LinkCompletionSink enum differentiating Service vs Invocation dispatch.
progress_update.goal: Implement complete linked services: Phase A (object linking, done), Phase A.2 (refactor completion model to LinkedFrom sinks, add AttachLinkCommand), Phase B (workflow invocation linking with InvocationEdges, StartLinkedCommand, coupled semantics).
accomplished: Designed and approved Phase A.2 plan: EntityId rename, LinkedFrom-as-sink model, LinkCompletionSink/LinkCompletionNotification, AttachLinkCommand, CompleteServiceCommand guard
Designed and approved Phase B plan: InvocationEdges table, StartLinkedCommand with Link response sink, WI child completion path, InvocationStatus::Completing

Resolved key design decisions through iterative discussion: coupled link+invocation semantics, LinkCompletionSink enum (Service/Invocation), LinkCompletionNotification { source, result, sink } unified message
Generated combined task breakdown: 7 phases, 12 parent tasks, 25 sub-tasks with dependency analysis and parallel execution waves
Established full link matrix: VO→VO (Phase A, complete), VO→WI, WI→VO, WI→WI (Phase B)

constraints: ServiceNodeId (not NodeId) — NodeId exists in restate_types for cluster nodes, renamed to EntityId
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None)
All tables are logical (2-byte KeyKind prefix) within one RocksDB CF per partition
Phase A.2 prepares LinkCompletionSink::Invocation variant but Phase B uses it
AttachLinkCommand works without InvocationEdges — LinkedFrom on child's ServiceEdges only
ServiceEdgeState proto oneof: LinkedToActive/LinkedToCompleted/LinkedFrom — edge label derived from variant
Completed objects reject new invocations at inbox AND state mutations from in-flight handlers
GC cascade: no LinkedFrom parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest
Direct cycle detection only via get_service_linked_from prefix scan
Design docs (docs/design/) NOT committed to this branch
decisions: EntityId replaces ServiceNodeId — Object(ServiceId) + WorkflowInvocation(InvocationId), LinkHandle = EntityId alias
LinkedFrom IS the completion sink — stores LinkCompletionSink::Service(ServiceId, Option<CompletionHandler>) or Invocation(InvocationId, Option<CompletionId>)
LinkedTo simplified to Active/Completed with no fields — all callback data lives on LinkedFrom
LinkCompletionNotification { source: EntityId, result: ResponseResult, sink: LinkCompletionSink } — unified, replaces ServiceCompletionNotification
Two edge tables: ServiceEdges (VO parents, service-level) + InvocationEdges (WI parents, invocation-scoped)
Coupled semantics: StartLinkedCommand link failure rejects the invocation entirely
ServiceInvocationResponseSink::Link piggybacks LinkedFrom write on invoke path, NOT used for completion notification
AttachLinkCommand follows AttachInvocationCommand pattern — cross-partition, adds Invocation sink to child's LinkedFrom
VO parents use onCompleted handlers, WI parents await directly or block via Completing — both blocked from completing with active children
ServiceEdgeState uses proto oneof to unify edge label + state — no separate edge_label param on put_service_edge
LinkedFrom edges store a minimal ServiceEdgeState::LinkedFrom proto value (not empty bytes) to prevent deserialization errors
onCompleted handler encodes failure details as JSON in argument bytes
LinkServiceResponse carries remote_node_id so on_link_service_response can clean up stale LinkedTo edge on error
Unlink (not RemoveLink) as the verb for edge removal — UnlinkServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceRequest, ctx.unlink()
VirtualObjectStatus: Unlocked | Locked(InvocationId) | Completed(ResponseResult) — mutually exclusive, Completed is terminal
Vertical command slices for linked-services implementation — each command task covers its full stack (journal + proto + codec + outbox + WAL)
GC cascade: no parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest to children
Phase A ships independently from Phase B (invocation linking) — Phase A anchors only objects, Phase B adds WorkflowInvocation nodes
